title: Kongzi: A Historical Large Language Model with Fact Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2504.09488v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can exhibit factual inaccuracies during long-chain reasoning or under misleading prompts, limiting their reliability in historical analysis. We propose Kongzi, a language model for historical understanding and reasoning that combines continued pre-training on historical corpora, supervised fine-tuning, and fact-enhanced reinforcement learning. Its factuality reward compares entities and relations extracted from generated responses with historical references through knowledge-graph similarity. We evaluate 0.5B and 7B models on historical question answering and counterfactual reasoning, using reported ratings from three LLM judges, and on CMMLU-Chinese-History. Kongzi-7B receives the highest historical-accuracy ratings among the compared models under all three judges. translated_title: 孔子：一种具有事实增强的历史大语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2504.09488v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）在长链推理过程中或在误导性提示下可能表现出事实性错误，这限制了其在历史分析中的可靠性。我们提出了孔子（Kongzi），一种面向历史理解与推理的语言模型，它结合了在历史语料库上的继续预训练、监督微调以及事实增强的强化学习。其事实性奖励通过知识图谱相似度，将从生成回复中提取的实体和关系与历史参考资料进行比较。我们在历史问答和反事实推理任务上评估了0.5B和7B两种规模的模型，使用三个LLM评判者给出的报告评分，并在CMMLU-Chinese-History（中国历史）基准上进行测试。在所有三个评判者的评估下，Kongzi-7B在所比较的模型中获得了最高的历史准确性评分。强化学习提高了两种模型规模的平均答案分数及其在CMMLU-Chinese-History上的准确率，尽管Kongzi-7B仍然...
tldr: 孔子是一个结合历史语料继续预训练、监督微调与基于知识图谱事实奖励的强化学习的历史大语言模型，显著提升了历史问答和推理中的事实准确性。
en_tdlr: Kongzi is a historical large language model that combines continued pre-training on historical corpora, supervised fine-tuning, and fact-enhanced reinforcement learning with knowledge-graph-based factuality rewards, achieving superior factual accuracy in historical question answering and reasoning.
